== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The initial surviving text protects your boosted Force drain against the opponent and forbids opposing movement throughout your turn while a captive is frozen. The earlier issuer gallery face keeps the full-turn timing and omits the protection. The dated 14 September 2007 replacement limits the prohibition to your battle phase. The earlier face’s 27 November capture dates the surviving copy.
